fields.Name: T172 - Test Explorer Suite And Type Rail Filter
fields.Description: Exercises the bespoke mj-left-nav suite/test-type tree filtering the explorer card grid (SelectSidebarItem, SuiteTreeNode) — distinct from the Data Explorer entity tree.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher next to the logo, choose "Testing". If the Explorer/Test Explorer view (a left rail listing 'All Items', 'Standalone Tests', test suites, and test types alongside a card grid) is reachable — via a sub-nav item or the Explorer tab — open it. In the left rail click a Test Suite node or a Test Type entry and confirm the card grid narrows to that selection (and the results count updates), then click 'All Items' to restore. Success is that rail selections drive the visible cards; a valid empty state for a selection with no items is also acceptable. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Test Explorer shows a left rail (All Items / Standalone Tests / Test Suites / Test Types) beside a card grid
Selecting a suite or test type in the rail narrows the card grid and/or updates the results count (or shows a valid empty state)
Selecting 'All Items' restores the full set
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
